terminals.name: backend
terminals.command: D=eve-trader; [ -d "$D" ] || D=.; cd "$D" && EVE_TRADER_PG_DSN='host=localhost port=5432 dbname=eve_trader_dev user=eve_trader_app password=app_devpassword' EVE_TRADER_PG_CONTAINER='' .venv/bin/uvicorn eve_trader.api.main:app --port 8000

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.command: D=eve-trader; [ -d "$D" ] || D=.; cd "$D/frontend" && npm run dev -- --host
